narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Storytelling -> Safety Procedures -> Technical Tip -> Alternative Method -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a helpful guide for Tesla owners, specifically those in Taiwan, on how to handle the immediate aftermath of a car accident. It uses a personal anecdote about a recent collision with a BMW to provide both general safety advice (placing triangles, calling police) and a specific technical tip on how to manually save critical dashcam footage using the Tesla touchscreen or the car horn.
